content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Bitcoin payments for digital downloads represent a paradigm shift for creators who are often locked out of traditional payment systems. By utilizing Bitcoin, you gain access to a decentralized financial infrastructure that allows you to sell directly to your customers without intermediary fees. This is particularly vital in regions with unstable currencies or strict banking regulations. By embracing this technology, you not only safeguard your income against high fees but also ensure immediate access to your funds, crucial for sustaining your digital business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture supporting Bitcoin payments is built on a range of free and open-source tools that work seamlessly together. Start with a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to showcase your products. Then, integrate Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend processing. For order management, leverage a database like Supabase or even Google Sheets. Finally, use NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. This stack operates without traditional payment gateways, allowing full control over your sales and data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is primarily designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment options are limited. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or design templates, having a reliable payment solution is essential. This setup is specifically tailored for individuals in countries like Nigeria and Kenya, where financial barriers can hinder creativity and innovation. By adopting this system, creators can enjoy the freedom to operate independently, ensuring their work reaches a global audience without being bogged down by high fees and restrictions.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5%, allowing you to keep more of your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this digital commerce stack include a hosting service, backend logic, a database, and a payment processor. Hosting platforms like GitHub Pages offer free hosting for your product pages, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage order processing. With Supabase or Google Sheets, you can store customer orders securely. Finally, NOWPayments handles the cryptocurrency payment transactions, ensuring a seamless experience for your buyers. Together, these tools create a robust framework for selling digital products effectively and efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital commerce stack today, start by choosing a hosting platform, like GitHub Pages, to set up your product page. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order logic. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Then, integrate NOWPayments to enable Bitcoin transactions. Finally, upload your digital products to a file delivery service like Google Drive. This step-by-step approach ensures you establish a fully operational store within 48 hours.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments. This service allows you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly, ensuring immediate transactions with minimal fees. This enables you to retain more of your earnings while providing a secure and efficient payment method for your customers.
Using Bitcoin, you can bypass traditional banking restrictions entirely.

It contains all the blueprints and templates needed to create your sovereign commerce stack effectively. Check out our offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for immediate access to these resources.
Your Deployment Checklist

Select a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your product page. Implement Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order processing logic. Configure a database using Supabase or Google Sheets to store your orders. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate Bitcoin transactions. Upload your digital products to a delivery service like Google Drive. Test the entire setup to ensure transactions are processed smoothly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online using NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin payments directly. This method allows you to bypass traditional payment processors, ensuring low fees and immediate access to your funds.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Utilizing a self-hosted solution with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees. This setup minimizes costs and maximizes your profit margin.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts independently by setting up your own digital store using free hosting services and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions.
What are the advantages of using Bitcoin for transactions?

Bitcoin transactions generally have lower fees compared to traditional payment processors, and they provide immediate access to funds. Additionally, Bitcoin operates independently of banking systems, making it ideal for creators in restricted regions.
How do I ensure secure delivery of my digital products?

To ensure secure delivery of your digital products, use a reliable file storage service like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to host your files. Combine this with automated delivery through backend scripts to manage access.
With full ownership of your infrastructure, your data and sales are always under your control.
